stem:
Students design an investigation to test the strength of different magnets. They use three magnets and steel paper clips. Each magnet is placed at a different distance from the steel paper clips. The table they will use to record their data is shown.

| Magnet | Distance from Steel Paper Clips (centimeters) | Number of Steel Paper Clips Attracted |
|--------|----------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------|
| 1      | 15                                           |                                       |
| 2      | 30                                           |                                       |
| 3      | 45                                           |                                       |

What should the students do to improve the investigation?

options.label: A
options.text: Use different steel objects for each magnet

options.label: B
options.text: Place the paper clips farther away from each magnet

options.label: C
options.text: Place each magnet at the same distance from the paper clips

options.label: D
options.text: Repeat the investigation using plastic paper clips

visual_elements: Table with three rows listing Magnet numbers 1, 2, 3; distances 15, 30, and 45 centimeters; and empty cells for Number of Steel Paper Clips Attracted
